T: You're so cool. So is this pie.
D: A comic shop clerk marries a call girl and the two go on the run to Hollywood with a suitcase they shouldn't have.
P: Serve the pie when Clarence and Alabama head to the diner after the kung fu triple feature.
S: Popcorn half with butter and salt, half with soy butter and sugar
Popcorn popped in coconut oil, tossed in melted butter and fine salt, a second batch tossed in butter, soy and a little sugar for the kung fu films. Served in big paper buckets.
Clarence's Detroit, before the road trip

Griddled cocktail franks in steamed mini rolls under a fine, spicy beef chilli sauce, yellow mustard and plenty of diced raw onion. Brown 250g fine beef mince with half a finely diced onion, breaking it up very small. Add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 20 minutes into a loose sauce. Griddle 16 cocktail franks until blistered. Steam 16 mini rolls for 1 minute. Fill with franks, spoon over the sauce and top with mustard and diced raw onion.
Baked choux puffs with cheddar and a pinch of cayenne
Choux pastry with sharp cheddar and cayenne, piped into small rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow, served warm.
M: the purple convertible from Detroit to LA

Two crispy smashed chuck patties with American cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce in soft buns, wrapped in paper, with crinkle-cut fries and purple slaw. Bake 800g crinkle-cut fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Toss a quarter of a red cabbage, shredded, with 2 tbsp mayo and lemon. Roll 800g chuck mince into 8 balls. Smash thin on a smoking griddle, season, cook 2 minutes, flip and add American cheese. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce and chopped pickles for sauce. Stack two patties per toasted bun with onion, pickles and sauce, and wrap in paper.
Hotel club sandwich and shoestring fries
Triple decker chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato sandwich, twice fried fries
Club sandwiches of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo on three slices of toast, cut into triangles, with a silver bowl of shoestring fries.
W: Lattice topped sour cherry pie with a touch of almond
Sour cherries tossed with sugar, lemon, a splash of almond extract and cornflour, in a lattice-topped pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled before slicing. Vanilla ice cream.
K: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime shaken into a salt rimmed glass
45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime shaken hard with ice, strained into a salt-rimmed glass.

dishes.make_ahead: Best popped just before serving; mix the soy and sugar into the butter up to 2 days ahead and rewarm to toss

steps.text: Pop the kernels in the coconut oil.
Toss half with melted butter and fine salt.
Toss the rest with butter melted with soy and sugar.
Serve in big paper buckets for the triple feature.
Boil the water and butter, beat in the flour and cook a minute.
Cool slightly, beat in the eggs, cheddar and cayenne.
Pipe small rounds.
Bake at 200C until puffed and hollow.

dishes.n: Hotel club sandwich and shoestring fries
dishes.make_ahead: Cut and fry the shoestrings the first time up to 2 hours ahead; grill the bacon, build the sandwiches and finish the fries just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into shoestrings and fry once in the oil.
Grill the bacon and toast the bread.
Layer chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise across three slices each and cut into triangles.
Fry the fries a second time until crisp.

veg.n: Hotel club sandwich and shoestring fries (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Boil and slice the eggs up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry the tofu, build the sandwiches and finish the fries just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into shoestrings and fry once in the oil.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and slice.
Fry the smoked tofu in a little of the oil until crisp, then splash with the soy sauce. Toast the bread.
Layer the tofu, egg, lettuce, sliced tomato and mayonnaise across three slices each and cut into triangles.
Fry the fries a second time until crisp.
Toss the cherries with the sugar, lemon juice, almond extract and cornflour.
Line a pie dish with two sheets of pastry and fill.
Weave a lattice from the other two sheets.
Bake at 190C.
Cool.
Serve with ice cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Juice the limes up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; shake each drink with ice to order

steps.text: Juice the limes and rim four glasses with salt.
Shake the tequila, orange liqueur and lime juice hard with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into the glasses.

af.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the green tea in the boiling water for 3 minutes, discard the bags and chill.
Juice the limes and orange and rim four glasses with salt.
Shake 40ml green tea, the orange juice, agave and lime juice hard with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into the glasses.

s.note: Popcorn half with butter and salt, half with soy butter and sugar
s.how: Pop 150g kernels in coconut oil. Toss half with 30g butter and fine salt. Toss the rest with 30g butter melted with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sugar. Serve in big paper buckets for the triple feature.

s.note: Baked choux puffs with cheddar and a pinch of cayenne
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs, 80g grated cheddar and a pinch of cayenne. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow.

m.n: Hotel club sandwich and shoestring fries
m.note: Triple decker chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato sandwich, twice fried fries
m.how: Grill 8 rashers bacon. Toast 12 slices white bread. Layer 300g roast chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo across three slices each and cut into triangles. Fry 1kg shoestring fries twice.

w.note: Lattice topped sour cherry pie with a touch of almond
w.how: Toss 800g sour cherries with 150g sugar, lemon juice, a drop of almond extract and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime shaken into a salt rimmed glass
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a salt-rimmed glass. Makes four. You're so cool.
